_tuning_notes: Lowland gorilla, the flagship. weight ~pig-tier for jungles; troops 3-6 with exactly one silverback (assigned in code, first adult of the group). chest_beat_cooldown_* is the silverback idle display window in ticks (30-90s); intimidate_* is the slowness-on-hostiles burst; foliage_tearing also needs mobGriefing on. tame_item: no bananas in vanilla, melon is our banana (1-in-3 per feed, hardcoded chance). Phase 3: forage block = melon/berry raids (mobGriefing-gated); a fed troop is 'content' for content_minutes: taming chance doubles (2/3), chest-beat cooldown doubles, roaming calms. cage_tier 2 = reinforced cage required.
guide_blurb: The jungle's gentle heavyweight - until you touch its family.
